<p>《铳梦》的创作始于1990年，最初在集英社的《Business Jump》杂志上连载。木城幸人受到当时赛博朋克文化浪潮的影响，同时结合了自己对哲学、社会学和人体改造技术的思考，创造出了这个独特的世界观。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>在创作之初，木城幸人想要探讨的核心问题是：「当人的身体可以被机械替代时，什么才是『人』的本质？」这个问题贯穿了整部作品，成为推动故事发展的核心动力。</p>\n                    \n                    <h3>时代背景</h3>\n                    <p>20世纪80年代末至90年代初，日本正处于泡沫经济的顶峰，同时也是赛博朋克文化在全球范围内兴起的时期。威廉·吉布森的《神经漫游者》、大友克洋的《阿基拉》等作品为木城幸人提供了丰富的灵感。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>在这样的时代背景下，木城幸人创造了「废铁镇」（ Scrapyard）这个充满混沌与希望的舞台——一个位于天空之城萨雷姆（Zalem）下方的巨大垃圾场，也是阳子（加里）苏醒和成长的地方。</p>\n                    \n                    <h3>影响与地位</h3>\n                    <p>《铳梦》不仅在日本漫画界取得了巨大成功，也在全球范围内产生了深远影响。它被翻译成多种语言，改编成动画、电影和游戏。2019年，由罗伯特·罗德里格兹执导、詹姆斯·卡梅隆监制的好莱坞电影《阿丽塔：战斗天使》上映，让更多人认识了这个故事。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>木城幸人通过《铳梦》，在赛博朋克的外壳下，包裹着一颗关于人性、记忆和自我认同的柔软内核。这也是这部作品能够跨越时代、感动无数读者的原因。</p>\n                </div>\n                <a href=\"../index.html#blog\" class=\"back-link\">← 返回博客列表</a>\n <p>萨雷姆是漂浮在废铁镇上方的天空之城，是这个世界的「上层阶级」居住地。萨雷姆的居民享受着最先进的科技和最优质的生活，他们从废铁镇收集资源，却对下方的苦难视而不见。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>萨雷姆象征着特权与隔离，它是废铁镇居民仰望却无法触及的存在。这种巨大的阶级差异，构成了整个故事的核心矛盾之一。</p>\n                    \n                    <h3>废铁镇（Scrapyard）</h3>\n                    <p>废铁镇是萨雷姆下方的巨大垃圾场，也是阳子苏醒的地方。这里是一个充满暴力、犯罪和生存挣扎的地方。居民们要么在工厂里劳作，要么在地下格斗场中搏命，要么成为猎人勇士（Hunter-Warrior）追杀悬赏犯。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>废铁镇是一个「适者生存」的世界，但正是在这样的环境中，人性的光辉才更加耀眼——医生依德（Daisuke Ido）的善良，阳子的正义，以及那些为了守护重要之人而战的人们。</p>\n                    \n                    <h3>人体改造与机甲术（Panzer Kunst）</h3>\n                    <p>在《铳梦》的世界里，人体改造技术已经非常成熟。许多人因为事故、疾病或单纯为了变强而将身体的一部分或全部替换成机械。这些被改造的人被称为「改造人」（Cyborg）。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>机甲术（Panzer Kunst）是来自火星的古老格斗术，专门为改造人设计。它将人体视为一种「乐器」，通过调整身体的「共振频率」来发挥最大的战斗力。阳子正是机甲术的继承者，这也是她强大战斗力的来源。</p>\n                    \n                    <h3>在绝望中寻找希望</h3>\n                    <p>《铳梦》的世界是悲壮的，但它从来不是绝望的。阳子从废铁镇的垃圾堆中醒来，失去了所有记忆，但她没有放弃——她在战斗中寻找自我，在守护中理解人性，在这个冰冷的赛博朋克世界中，用她的钢铁之躯，燃烧着炽热的灵魂。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>这就是《铳梦》的世界观——一个充满黑暗与苦难的世界，但正是在这样的世界里，希望才显得更加珍贵，人性才显得更加耀眼。</p>\n                </div>\n                <a href=\"../index.html#blog\" class=\"back-link\">← 返回博客列表</a>\n            </article>\n\n <p>阳子（Gally，英文译名为 Alita）的故事，是一个关于「寻找自我」的故事。她从废铁镇的垃圾堆中醒来，失去了所有记忆，但她的灵魂却在一次次的战斗和守护中，逐渐苏醒，最终找到了真正的「自我」。</p>\n                    \n                    <h3>苏醒：垃圾堆中的少女</h3>\n                    <p>阳子的故事始于废铁镇的垃圾堆。医生依德（Daisuke Ido）在垃圾中发现了她的头颅——一个还有生命迹象的改造人头颅。依德将她带回诊所，为她组装了一具新的身体，并给她取名为「加里」（Gally）。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>此时的阳子，只是一个失忆的少女，对这个世界一无所知。她好奇地探索着废铁镇的每一个角落，像一个新生儿一样，重新学习着如何「做人」。</p>\n                    \n                    <h3>觉醒：机甲术的回响</h3>\n                    <p>阳子的第一次觉醒，是在她第一次面对危险的时候。当她和依德遇到悬赏犯时，她的身体本能地动了起来——她用一种她自己都不记得的格斗术，轻松击败了敌人。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>这种格斗术，就是来自火星的「机甲术」（Panzer Kunst）。阳子的身体记得这种战斗方式，尽管她的大脑已经失去了记忆。这是她过去的残响，也是她寻找自我的第一条线索。</p>\n                    \n                    <h3>挣扎：在战斗中寻找意义</h3>\n                    <p>在觉醒了机甲术之后，阳子成为了一名猎人勇士（Hunter-Warrior），开始在废铁镇的地下格斗场中战斗。她在战斗中寻找着什么——是过去的记忆？是生存的意义？还是仅仅是为了战斗本身？</p>\n                    \n                    <p>在这个过程中，阳子遇到了各种各样的人——善良的依德，野心勃勃的萨曼（Zapan），以及她的爱人雨果（Hugo）。这些人，以及与他们的交集，让阳子逐渐理解了什么是「重要的东西」，什么是「值得守护的东西」。</p>\n                    \n                    <h3>重生：成为战斗天使</h3>\n                    <p>阳子的真正重生，是在她失去雨果之后。雨果的死让阳子痛苦，但也让她明白了——她的存在，不是为了过去的记忆，而是为了守护现在和未来。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>从那以后，阳子不再是那个在垃圾堆中醒来的失忆少女，而是成为了「战斗天使」——一个为了守护重要之人而战，为了反抗不公而战，为了寻找自我而战的战士。</p>\n                    \n                    <h3>寻找：永无止境的旅程</h3>\n                    <p>阳子的故事，是一个永无止境的寻找自我的旅程。她的记忆在逐渐恢复，她的过去在逐渐清晰，但她知道——「真正的自我」，不是存在于过去的记忆中，而是存在于现在的每一次选择、每一次战斗、每一次守护中。</p>\n <p>我睁开眼睛的时候，发现自己躺在一堆生锈的金属和废弃的零件中间。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>那是废铁镇的垃圾堆，位于天空之城萨雷姆下方的巨大垃圾场。我的身体只剩下一个头颅——或者说，是一个还有生命迹象的改造人头颅。我不记得自己是谁，不记得自己来自哪里，甚至不记得自己的名字。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>后来，依德医生告诉我，他给我取名叫「加里」（Gally）。但在我灵魂的深处，总有一个声音在回响——「阳子」（Yoko）。那是我过去的名字，是我还没变成现在这个样子之前的名字。</p>\n                    \n                    <h3>第一章：垃圾堆中的觉醒</h3>\n                    \n                    <p>依德医生是废铁镇的一名改造人医生。他在垃圾堆里发现了我，把我带回了他的诊所，为我组装了一具新的身体。那是一具少女的身体——纤细、灵活，但充满了力量。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>刚开始的时候，我对这个世界一无所知。我像一个新生儿一样，好奇地探索着废铁镇的每一个角落——肮脏的街道，破旧的房屋，地下的格斗场，还有那些为了生存而挣扎的人们。废铁镇是一个「适者生存」的地方，暴力、犯罪和死亡在这里是家常便饭。但即使在这样的环境中，我也能感受到人性的光辉——依德医生的善良，那些在困境中仍然互相帮助的人们。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>我的第一次觉醒，是在我和依德医生遇到悬赏犯的时候。当那个男人举着刀向我们冲过来的时候，我的身体本能地动了起来。我用一种我自己都不记得的格斗术，轻松地击败了他。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>后来我才知道，那种格斗术叫做「机甲术」（Panzer Kunst）——一种来自火星的古老格斗术，专门为改造人设计。它将人体视为一种「乐器」，通过调整身体的「共振频率」来发挥最大的战斗力。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>我的身体记得这种格斗术，尽管我的大脑已经失去了记忆。这是我过去的残响——是我还是「阳子」的时候，刻在我灵魂深处的东西。</p>\n                    \n                    <h3>第二章：雨果——我想要守护的第一个人</h3>\n                    \n                    <p>在废铁镇的日子里，我遇到了很多人，但改变我最多的，是雨果（Hugo）。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>雨果是一个梦想着去萨雷姆的少年。萨雷姆是漂浮在废铁镇上方的天空之城，是废铁镇居民仰望却无法触及的存在。雨果相信，只要他能赚到足够的钱，就能买到去萨雷姆的资格。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>我和雨果相爱了。和他在一起的日子，是我在废铁镇最快乐的时光。我们一起在废铁镇的街道上奔跑，一起看萨雷姆的灯光，一起梦想着未来。雨果告诉我，萨雷姆是一个完美的地方——没有暴力，没有贫穷，没有死亡。他说，只要我们能去萨雷姆，就能永远幸福地生活在一起。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>但我后来才知道，雨果的梦想是建立在一个谎言之上的。萨雷姆根本不是什么完美的地方——它是一个建立在废铁镇苦难之上的特权阶层居住地。萨雷姆的居民从废铁镇收集资源，却对下方的苦难视而不见。而且，根本没有「买到去萨雷姆的资格」这种事——那些所谓的「资格」，只是萨雷姆用来欺骗废铁镇居民的谎言。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>雨果发现了这个真相。他崩溃了。他爬上了连接萨雷姆和废铁镇的管道，想要自己爬到萨雷姆去。我追了上去，想要阻止他。但已经太晚了——雨果从管道上掉了下去，死在了我的怀里。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>雨果的死，是我人生中最痛苦的时刻。我抱着他逐渐冰冷的身体，感觉自己的灵魂也随着他一起死去了。但也就是在这个时刻，我明白了——我的存在，不是为了过去的记忆，而是为了守护现在和未来。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>雨果教会了我什么是「爱」，什么是「想要守护一个人的心情」。他虽然死了，但他的精神却永远留在了我的心里。从那以后，我不再是那个在垃圾堆中醒来的失忆少女——我成为了「战斗天使」，一个为了守护重要之人而战的战士。</p>\n                    \n                    <h3>第三章：成为 TUNED——在萨雷姆的阴影下</h3>\n <p>最终，我恢复了记忆。我背叛了萨雷姆，逃了出来。我不再是萨雷姆的工具——我是阳子，是加里，是一个有自己的意志、自己的感情、自己想要守护的东西的「人」。</p>\n                    \n                    <h3>第四章：火星的记忆——我真正的过去</h3>\n                    \n                    <p>在逃离萨雷姆之后，我开始寻找自己真正的过去。我记得自己来自火星——那是机甲术的发源地，也是我还是「阳子」的时候生活的地方。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>火星是一个战火纷飞的地方。在我还是阳子的时候，火星正在进行一场残酷的战争——「星球大战」（Planet Wars）。我是火星联邦军的一名战士，也是机甲术的继承者。我在战场上杀死了很多人，也失去了很多重要的人。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>最终，我在一场战斗中受了重伤。我的战友们以为我死了，把我的头颅放进了一个冷冻舱，送到了地球。但冷冻舱在进入地球大气层的时候出了故障，掉在了废铁镇的垃圾堆里——这就是我故事的开始。</p>\n  <p>我不再为过去的记忆而痛苦，也不再为自己的身份而困惑。我就是我——阳子，同时也是加里。我的过去塑造了我，但我的现在和未来，是由我自己的选择决定的。</p>\n                    \n                    <h3>第五章：自我追寻——我为什么而战？</h3>\n                    \n                    <p>在我的人生中，我一直在问自己一个问题——「我为什么而战？」</p>\n                    \n                    <p>刚开始的时候，我战斗是因为身体的本能——机甲术的残响，让我在遇到危险的时候自动战斗。后来，我战斗是为了守护雨果——我想要用自己的力量，守护我爱的人。再后来，我战斗是为了反抗萨雷姆——我不愿意再做一个被人控制的工具，我想要自己决定自己的命运。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>而现在，我战斗是为了「守护」——守护那些重要的人，守护那些美好的东西，守护这个虽然充满苦难，但仍然值得我们去爱的世界。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>我知道，我的旅程还没有结束。我还有很多东西要去寻找，很多东西要去守护。但我不再害怕——因为我知道，我不是一个人在战斗。依德医生的善良，雨果的爱，还有那些支持我的朋友们——他们都是我力量的源泉。</p>\n                    \n                    <h3>终章：记忆的残响与未来的希望</h3>\n                    \n <p>在《铳梦》的世界里，科技已经高度发达——人体可以被机械替代，记忆可以被数字化，甚至连灵魂都可以被存储在芯片里。但在这个「高科技，低生活」（High Tech, Low Life）的赛博朋克世界里，真正珍贵的东西，从来都不是科技——而是人性。</p>\n                    \n                    <h3>第一章：萨雷姆与废铁镇——两个世界的分裂</h3>\n                    \n                    <p>《铳梦》的世界观，建立在一个巨大的阶级分裂之上——天空之城萨雷姆（Zalem），和下方的废铁镇（Scrapyard）。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>萨雷姆是漂浮在废铁镇上方的天空之城，是这个世界的「上层阶级」居住地。萨雷姆的居民享受着最先进的科技和最优质的生活——干净的街道，舒适的房屋，完善的医疗和教育。他们从废铁镇收集资源，包括食物、水、矿产，甚至是改造人的零件。但他们对废铁镇的苦难视而不见——在他们看来，废铁镇的居民只是「下等人」，是为萨雷姆服务的「工具」。</p>\n                    \n                  \n                    <p>萨雷姆和废铁镇的分裂，不仅仅是地理上的分裂——更是人心上的分裂。萨雷姆的居民，把自己视为「高等人」，把废铁镇的居民视为「下等人」。但他们不知道——真正的「高等」，从来都不是你住在哪里，你有多少钱，你有多强的科技——真正的「高等」，是你有一颗善良的心，是你愿意守护那些重要的人，是你在黑暗中仍然愿意相信希望。</p>\n                    \n                    <h3>第二章：改造人与「人」的本质——当身体可以被机械替代时，什么才是「人」？</h3>\n                    \n                    <p>在《铳梦》的世界里，人体改造技术已经非常成熟。许多人因为事故、疾病或单纯为了变强而将身体的一部分或全部替换成机械。这些被改造的人被称为「改造人」（Cyborg）。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>我自己就是一个改造人——我的身体除了大脑之外，几乎全部都是机械。在我刚开始在废铁镇醒来的时候，我曾经问过自己一个问题——「我还是一个『人』吗？」</p>\n                    \n                    <p>萨雷姆的人认为，改造人不是「人」——他们只是「机器」，是「工具」。他们可以随意地改造我们的身体，抹去我们的记忆，把我们变成杀人机器。但我知道——他们错了。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>「人」的本质，从来都不是你的身体——而是你的心，你的记忆，你的感情，你想要守护重要之人的心情。即使你的身体变成了机械，只要你的心还是柔软的，只要你还能爱，还能恨，还能笑，还能哭——你就是一个「人」。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>我见过很多改造人——有些人为了变强，把自己的身体改造成了杀人机器，失去了所有的感情；但也有一些人，即使身体变成了机械，却仍然保持着一颗善良的心——比如依德医生，比如雨果，比如那些在废铁镇仍然互相帮助的人们。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>相反，我也见过很多「普通人」——他们的身体是血肉之躯，但他们的心却比机械还要冰冷——比如萨雷姆的那些统治者，比如那些为了钱可以出卖一切的人，比如那些把改造人视为「工具」的人。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>所以——「人」和「非人」的区别，从来都不是你的身体是血肉还是机械——而是你的心，你的灵魂，你是否还能感受到那些「人」应该感受到的东西。</p>\n                    \n                    <h3>第三章：记忆与自我——当记忆可以被抹去时，「我」是谁？</h3>\n                    \n                    <p>在《铳梦》的世界里，记忆也可以被数字化——可以被存储，可以被复制，可以被抹去，甚至可以被修改。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>我自己就经历过记忆被抹去的情况——当我被萨雷姆的 TUNED 计划选中的时候，他们抹去了我所有的记忆，把我变成了一个没有感情的杀人机器。那时候的我，不知道自己是谁，不知道自己从哪里来，不知道自己为什么而战——我只是一个「工具」，一个执行命令的机器。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>但即使在那种状态下，我的灵魂深处仍然有什么东西在反抗——是雨果的记忆，是依德医生的善良，是我作为「阳子」的过去。那些记忆虽然被抹去了，但它们并没有消失——它们藏在我的灵魂深处，等待着被唤醒的那一天。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>后来，我恢复了记忆——我想起了自己是谁，想起了自己从哪里来，想起了那些重要的人和事。但在那个时候，我也明白了——「我」是谁，从来都不是由我的记忆决定的——而是由我的选择，我的行动，我想要守护的东西决定的。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>记忆确实很重要——它们是我们过去的证明，是我们灵魂的一部分。但即使失去了记忆，「我」仍然是「我」——因为我的心，我的灵魂，我想要守护重要之人的心情，这些东西是不会被抹去的。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>所以——当记忆可以被抹去时，「我」是谁？答案很简单——「我」就是「我」，是那个在当下做出选择的人，是那个在当下守护重要之人的人，是那个在当下仍然愿意相信希望的人。</p>\n                    \n                    <h3>第四章：暴力与对话——战斗，也是一种交流</h3>\n                    \n                    <p>在《铳梦》的世界里，暴力是无处不在的——废铁镇的地下格斗场，死亡球比赛，萨雷姆的秘密行动，还有火星的星球大战。我自己也杀过很多人——在火星的战场上，在废铁镇的地下格斗场，在死亡球的赛场上，在作为 TUNED 特工的时候。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>刚开始的时候，我只是为了战斗而战斗——要么是因为身体的本能，要么是为了生存，要么是为了任务。但后来，我明白了——战斗，其实也是一种对话。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>机甲术（Panzer Kunst）的理念，就是「战斗即对话」——在战斗中，你通过调整身体的「共振频率」，来和对手进行交流。你感受对手的节奏，理解对手的意图，然后用自己的力量做出回应。这不仅仅是力量的碰撞——更是灵魂的对话。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>在我战斗过的对手中，有一些人是我的敌人——他们想要杀我，想要利用我，想要控制我。但也有一些人，虽然是对手，但却是值得尊重的——他们和我一样，有自己想要守护的东西，有自己的信念，有自己的原则。和这些人战斗，虽然身体会受伤，但灵魂却会得到成长——因为在战斗中，我理解了他们，他们也理解了我。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>当然，暴力不是解决问题的最好方式——如果可以的话，我更愿意用语言来交流，用理解来化解矛盾。但在这个充满黑暗和绝望的世界里，有时候，你必须用战斗来守护重要的东西，必须用战斗来传达自己的意志，必须用战斗来让对方听到自己的声音。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>所以——战斗，也是一种对话。它不是为了杀戮，而是为了守护；它不是为了毁灭，而是为了创造；它不是为了证明自己的强大，而是为了传达自己的意志。</p>\n                    \n                    <h3>第五章：希望——在废墟中寻找光明</h3>\n                    \n                    <p>《铳梦》的世界，是一个充满黑暗和绝望的世界——萨雷姆的压迫，废铁镇的苦难，战争的残酷，人性的丑恶。但就是在这样的世界里，我仍然看到了希望——依德医生的善良，雨果的梦想，那些在困境中仍然互相帮助的人们，还有那些在战斗中仍然保持着信念的对手。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>希望，从来都不是「没有痛苦」「没有黑暗」「没有绝望」——希望，是在痛苦中仍然愿意相信未来，是在黑暗中仍然愿意寻找光明，是在绝望中仍然愿意站起来继续前进。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>我自己就经历过很多次绝望——雨果的死，记忆被抹去，被萨雷姆控制，在火星战场上失去一切。但每次我以为自己撑不下去的时候，总有什么东西支撑着我——是雨果的笑容，是依德医生的鼓励，是那些支持我的朋友们，是我想要守护重要之人的心情。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>所以——即使世界充满黑暗和绝望，也不要放弃希望。因为在废墟中，仍然有光明；在苦难中，仍然有幸福；在绝望中，仍然有希望。只要你愿意站起来，继续前进，继续守护，继续相信——你就一定能找到属于自己的光明。</p>\n                    \n                    <h3>终章：人性的微光——在钢铁与血肉之间</h3>\n                    \n                    <p>在《铳梦》的世界里，科技可以改变我们的身体，可以抹去我们的记忆，可以控制我们的行为。但有一样东西，是科技永远无法改变的——那就是我们的人性，我们的灵魂，我们想要守护重要之人的心情。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>我的身体是钢铁，但我的心是血肉；我的记忆可以被抹去，但我的灵魂永远存在；我可以被控制，但我的意志永远自由。这就是我——阳子（加里），一个在钢铁与血肉之间，寻找着人性微光的改造人。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>我相信，在这个世界上，无论科技多么发达，无论社会多么黑暗，人性的微光永远不会消失。它可能很微弱，可能很渺小，可能很容易被忽视——但它永远存在，永远在那里，等待着被发现，被守护，被传递。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>这就是《铳梦》想要告诉我们的——在这个「高科技，低生活」的赛博朋克世界里，真正珍贵的东西，从来都不是科技——而是人性。只要我们仍然保持着一颗善良的心，仍然愿意守护重要的人，仍然愿意相信希望——我们就永远是「人」，我们就永远有希望。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>——阳子（加里）</p>\n </ul>\n            </nav>\n        </div>\n    </header>\n\n    <section class=\"section\">\n        <div class=\"container\">\n            <article class=\"blog-post-full\">\n                <h2 class=\"post-title-full\">木城幸人的创作宇宙——《铳梦》背后的哲学思考与人文关怀</h2>\n                <p class=\"post-date-full\">2025-02-15</p>\n                <div class=\"post-content\">\n                    <p>木城幸人（Yukito Kishiro），1967年3月20日出生于日本东京，是日本著名的漫画家。他的代表作《铳梦》（Gunnm，英文译名为 Battle Angel Alita），不仅仅是一部精彩的赛博朋克漫画，更是一部充满哲学思考与人文关怀的作品。</p>\n                    \n                    <h3>第一章：木城幸人的创作背景与时代</h3>\n                    \n                    <p>木城幸人的创作生涯，始于20世纪80年代末至90年代初——那是一个特殊的时代。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>在日本国内，泡沫经济正处于顶峰，整个社会沉浸在「永远繁荣」的幻想之中。但在表面的繁华之下，却隐藏着深刻的社会问题——贫富差距的扩大，人际关系的冷漠，传统价值观的崩溃。与此同时，赛博朋克文化正在全球范围内兴起——威廉·吉布森的《神经漫游者》（Neuromancer），大友克洋的《阿基拉》（Akira），这些作品为木城幸人提供了丰富的灵感。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>在这样的时代背景下，木城幸人开始创作《铳梦》。1990年，《铳梦》开始在集英社的《Business Jump》杂志上连载。这部作品，从一开始就不仅仅是一部娱乐性的漫画——它是木城幸人对这个时代的思考，对人性的探索，对未来的追问。</p>\n                    \n                    <h3>第二章：「人」的本质——木城幸人的核心追问</h3>\n                    \n                    <p>《铳梦》的核心主题，是「人」的本质——当人的身体可以被机械替代时，什么才是「人」？当人的记忆可以被抹去时，「我」是谁？当科技可以控制一切时，自由意志还存在吗？</p>\n                    \n                    <p>木城幸人对这些问题的回答，是充满人文关怀的。他认为——「人」的本质，从来都不是身体，而是心；不是记忆，而是选择；不是科技，而是灵魂。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>这一点，在阳子（加里）的身上体现得淋漓尽致。阳子是一个改造人——她的身体除了大脑之外，几乎全部都是机械。她的记忆曾经被抹去，她曾经被萨雷姆控制，成为一个没有感情的杀人机器。但即使在这样的情况下，她仍然保持着一颗善良的心，仍然有着自己的意志，仍然想要守护重要的人。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>木城幸人通过阳子的故事告诉我们——「人」的定义，从来都不是由你的身体、你的记忆、你的出身决定的——而是由你的选择、你的行动、你想要守护的东西决定的。只要你有一颗善良的心，只要你有自己的意志，只要你愿意守护重要的人——你就是一个「人」，一个值得被尊重的「人」。</p>\n                    \n                    <h3>第三章：阶级与压迫——对社会不平等的批判</h3>\n                    \n                    <p>《铳梦》的另一个核心主题，是阶级与压迫——天空之城萨雷姆与下方的废铁镇，构成了一个典型的「上层-下层」社会结构。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>萨雷姆是特权阶层的居住地——他们享受着最先进的科技和最优质的生活，却对废铁镇的苦难视而不见。他们从废铁镇收集资源，却认为废铁镇的居民只是「下等人」，是为他们服务的「工具」。而废铁镇的居民，则生活在暴力、贫困和绝望之中——他们要么在工厂里劳作，要么在地下格斗场中搏命，要么成为猎人勇士，用生命换取微薄的收入。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>木城幸人通过萨雷姆与废铁镇的对比，批判了社会的不平等，批判了特权阶层的冷漠，批判了「出身决定命运」的不公。但他并没有停留在批判上——他还通过阳子的故事，告诉我们——即使生活在社会的最底层，即使被整个世界抛弃，你仍然可以有自己的意志，仍然可以做出自己的选择，仍然可以守护重要的人，仍然可以找到属于自己的希望。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>这就是木城幸人的人文关怀——他不仅看到了社会的黑暗，更看到了黑暗中的人性微光；他不仅批判了社会的不公，更给出了反抗不公的方式——不是暴力，不是仇恨，而是善良，而是守护，而是希望。</p>\n                    \n                    <h3>第四章：记忆与自我——对身份认同的探索</h3>\n                    \n                    <p>在《铳梦》中，记忆是一个非常重要的主题——阳子的记忆曾经被抹去，后来又逐渐恢复；萨雷姆可以通过修改记忆来控制人们；许多改造人因为失去记忆而陷入困惑，不知道自己是谁。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>木城幸人对记忆与自我的关系的思考，是非常深刻的。他认为——记忆确实很重要，它是我们过去的证明，是我们灵魂的一部分。但「我」是谁，从来都不是由记忆决定的——而是由我们的选择，我们的行动，我们想要守护的东西决定的。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>阳子的故事，就是这一思考的最好体现。当她的记忆被抹去的时候，她不知道自己是谁，不知道自己从哪里来，但她仍然是阳子——因为她的善良，她的勇气，她想要守护重要之人的心情，这些东西是不会被抹去的。而当她恢复记忆的时候，她也没有被过去的记忆束缚——她接受了自己的过去，但更重视自己的现在和未来。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>木城幸人通过阳子的故事告诉我们——不要被过去的记忆束缚，不要被自己的出身定义，不要被别人的期待左右。「我」是谁，是由当下的自己决定的——是由你当下的选择，当下的行动，当下想要守护的东西决定的。</p>\n                    \n                    <h3>第五章：战斗与对话——木城幸人的暴力美学</h3>\n                    \n                    <p>《铳梦》中有很多战斗场景——废铁镇的地下格斗场，死亡球比赛，萨雷姆的秘密行动，火星的星球大战。但木城幸人笔下的战斗，从来都不是为了暴力而暴力——战斗，也是一种对话。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>机甲术（Panzer Kunst）的理念，就是「战斗即对话」——在战斗中，你通过调整身体的「共振频率」，来和对手进行交流。你感受对手的节奏，理解对手的意图，然后用自己的力量做出回应。这不仅仅是力量的碰撞——更是灵魂的对话。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>木城幸人笔下的战斗，从来都不是为了杀戮，而是为了守护；从来都不是为了毁灭，而是为了创造；从来都不是为了证明自己的强大，而是为了传达自己的意志。阳子的每一次战斗，都是为了守护重要的人，都是为了反抗不公，都是为了传达自己的意志——「我不是你的工具，我的存在，是由我自己的挣扎来定义的。」</p>\n                    \n                    <p>这就是木城幸人的暴力美学——暴力不是目的，而是手段；战斗不是为了杀戮，而是为了对话；力量不是为了压迫，而是为了守护。</p>\n                    \n                    <h3>第六章：希望——木城幸人的终极关怀</h3>\n                    \n                    <p>《铳梦》的世界，是一个充满黑暗和绝望的世界——萨雷姆的压迫，废铁镇的苦难，战争的残酷，人性的丑恶。但木城幸人并没有让这个世界陷入完全的黑暗——他在黑暗中，留下了希望的微光。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>希望，是《铳梦》的终极主题——依德医生的善良，是希望；雨果的梦想，是希望；阳子的勇气，是希望；那些在困境中仍然互相帮助的人们，是希望。木城幸人告诉我们——即使世界充满黑暗和绝望，也不要放弃希望。因为在废墟中，仍然有光明；在苦难中，仍然有幸福；在绝望中，仍然有希望。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>阳子的故事，就是一个关于希望的故事——她从废铁镇的垃圾堆中醒来，失去了所有记忆，但她没有放弃；她失去了雨果，陷入了巨大的痛苦，但她没有放弃；她被萨雷姆控制，成为了杀人机器，但她没有放弃。她一次又一次地站起来，继续前进，继续守护，继续寻找——因为她相信，希望是存在的，未来是可以改变的，自己的命运是可以由自己决定的。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>这就是木城幸人的终极关怀——无论世界多么黑暗，无论人生多么痛苦，都不要放弃希望。因为只要你愿意站起来，继续前进，继续守护，继续相信——你就一定能找到属于自己的光明，你就一定能改变自己的命运，你就一定能让这个世界变得更好一点。</p>\n                    \n                    <h3>终章：木城幸人的创作遗产——在黑暗中寻找希望</h3>\n                    \n                    <p>《铳梦》从1990年开始连载，至今已经超过30年了。在这30年里，它被翻译成多种语言，改编成动画、电影和游戏，感动了全世界无数的读者。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>《铳梦》之所以能够跨越时代，感动无数人，是因为它不仅仅是一部精彩的赛博朋克漫画——更是一部充满哲学思考与人文关怀的作品。木城幸人通过阳子的故事，探讨了「人」的本质，批判了社会的不平等，探索了身份认同，展现了暴力美学，传达了希望的力量。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>在今天这个科技飞速发展的时代，《铳梦》的主题显得更加重要——当AI越来越强大，当元宇宙越来越接近现实，当我们越来越多地生活在数字世界里，我们更需要思考——「人」的本质是什么？我们是谁？我们想要守护什么？我们应该如何面对这个充满变化的世界？</p>\n                    \n                    <p>木城幸人通过《铳梦》给出了他的答案——「人」的本质，是心，是灵魂，是想要守护重要之人的心情；我们是谁，是由我们的选择、我们的行动、我们想要守护的东西决定的；我们想要守护的，是那些重要的人，是那些美好的东西，是这个虽然充满苦难，但仍然值得我们去爱的世界；我们应该如何面对这个充满变化的世界？——不要害怕变化，不要被过去束缚，不要放弃希望，要站起来，继续前进，继续守护，继续相信。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>这就是木城幸人的创作遗产——在黑暗中寻找希望，在钢铁与血肉之间守护人性，在这个充满变化的世界里，做一个有温度、有意志、有爱的「人」。</p>\n                    \n                    <p>——阳子（加里）</p>\n                </div>\n vector-page-toolbar-container\n::: {#left-navigation}\n::: {#p-associated-pages .vector-menu .vector-menu-tabs .mw-portlet .mw-portlet-associated-pages}\n--\n## Plot {#Plot}\n\n[[\\[]{.mw-editsection-bracket}[edit](/w/index.php?title=Battle_Angel_Alita&action=edit&section=1 \"Edit section: Plot\")[\\]]{.mw-editsection-bracket}]{.mw-editsection}\n:::\n\n*Battle Angel Alita* tells the story of\n[Alita](/wiki/Alita_(Battle_Angel_Alita) \"Alita (Battle Angel Alita)\"),\nan [amnesiac](/wiki/Amnesia \"Amnesia\") female\n[cyborg](/wiki/Cyborg \"Cyborg\"). Her intact head and chest, in\n[suspended animation](/wiki/Suspended_animation \"Suspended animation\"),\nare found by cyber medic expert Daisuke Ido in the local garbage dump.\nIdo manages to revive her, and finding she has lost her memory, names\nher Alita after his recently deceased cat. The rebuilt Alita soon\ndiscovers that she instinctively remembers the legendary martial art,\nPanzer Kunst, although she does not recall anything else. Alita uses her\nPanzer Kunst to first become a [bounty\nhunter](/wiki/Bounty_hunter \"Bounty hunter\"), killing cyborg criminals\nin the Scrapyard, and then as a star player in the brutal\n[gladiator](/wiki/Gladiator \"Gladiator\") sport of Motorball. While in\ncombat, Alita awakens memories of her earlier life on Mars. She becomes\ninvolved with the floating city of Zalem (Tiphares in some older\ntranslations) as one of their agents and is sent to hunt down criminals.\nForemost is the mad genius Desty Nova, who has a complex, ever-changing\nrelationship with\nAlita.^[[\\[]{.cite-bracket}5[\\]]{.cite-bracket}](#cite_note-6)^\n\nThe futuristic [dystopian](/wiki/Dystopian \"Dystopian\"){.mw-redirect}\nworld of *Battle Angel Alita* revolves around the city of Scrapyard\n(Kuzutetsu in the Japanese and various other versions), which has grown\nup around a massive scrap heap that rains down from Zalem. Ground\ndwellers have no access to Zalem and are forced to make a living in the\nsprawl below. Many are heavily modified by cybernetics to better cope\nwith their hard life.\n\nZalem exploits the Scrapyard and surrounding farms, paying bounty\nhunters (called Hunter-Warriors) to hunt criminals and arranging violent\nsports to keep the population entertained. Massive tubes connect the\nScrapyard to Zalem, and the city uses robots for carrying out errands\nand providing security on the ground. Occasionally, Zalemites (such as\nDaisuke Ido and Desty Nova) are exiled and sent to the ground. Aside\nfrom the robots and exiles, there is little contact between the two\ncities.\n\nThe story takes place in the former United States. According to a map,\nprinted in the eighth volume, Scrapyard/Zalem is near [Kansas City,\nMissouri](/wiki/Kansas_City,_Missouri \"Kansas City, Missouri\"), and the\nNecropolis is [Colorado Springs,\nColorado](/wiki/Colorado_Springs,_Colorado \"Colorado Springs, Colorado\").\nRadio KAOS is at [Dallas,\nTexas](/wiki/Dallas,_Texas \"Dallas, Texas\"){.mw-redirect}. Figure\\'s\ncoastal hometown is [Alhambra,\nCalifornia](/wiki/Alhambra,_California \"Alhambra, California\"). Desty\nNova\\'s Granite Inn is built out of a military\nbase---[NORAD](/wiki/NORAD \"NORAD\") at [Cheyenne Mountain\nComplex](/wiki/Cheyenne_Mountain_Complex \"Cheyenne Mountain Complex\"),\n[Colorado](/wiki/Colorado \"Colorado\").^[[\\[]{.cite-bracket}6[\\]]{.cite-bracket}](#cite_note-kudoslist-7)^\n\n*Battle Angel Alita* is eventually revealed to take place in the 26th\ncentury. The sequel *Battle Angel Alita: Last Order* introduces a\n[calendar era](/wiki/Calendar_era \"Calendar era\") called \\\"Era\n[Sputnik](/wiki/Sputnik_1 \"Sputnik 1\")\\\" which has an\n[epoch](/wiki/Epoch_(reference_date) \"Epoch (reference date)\"){.mw-redirect}\nof AD 1957. The original *Battle Angel Alita* series begins in ES 577\n(AD 2533) and ends in ES 590 (AD 2546), *Battle Angel Alita: Last Order*\nis mostly set roughly in ES 591 (AD 2547), and *Battle Angel Alita: Mars\nChronicle* alternates between ES 373--374 (AD 2329--2330) and ES 594 (AD\n2550).\n\n::: {.mw-heading .mw-heading2}\n## Characters {#Characters}\n\n[[\\[]{.mw-editsection-bracket}[edit](/w/index.php?title=Battle_Angel_Alita&action=edit&section=2 \"Edit section: Characters\")[\\]]{.mw-editsection-bracket}]{.mw-editsection}\n:::\n\n::: {.hatnote .navigation-not-searchable role=\"note\"}\nMain article: [List of *Battle Angel Alita*\ncharacters](/wiki/List_of_Battle_Angel_Alita_characters \"List of Battle Angel Alita characters\")\n:::\n\n*Battle Angel Alita* features a diverse cast of characters, many of whom\nshift in and out of focus as the story progresses. Some are never to be\nseen again following the conclusion of a story arc, while others make\nrecurring appearances. The one character who remains a constant\nthroughout is\n[Alita](/wiki/Alita_(Battle_Angel_Alita) \"Alita (Battle Angel Alita)\"),\nthe [protagonist](/wiki/Protagonist \"Protagonist\") and title character,\na young cyborg with amnesia struggling to uncover her forgotten past\nthrough the only thing she remembers from it: by fighting. Early on in\nthe story, [Daisuke\nIdo](/wiki/List_of_Battle_Angel_Alita_characters#Daisuke_Ido \"List of Battle Angel Alita characters\"),\na [bounty-hunting](/wiki/Bounty_hunter \"Bounty hunter\") cybernetic\ndoctor who finds and revives Alita, plays a major role as well, but\nmidway the focus begins to increasingly shift to [Desty\nNova](/wiki/Desty_Nova \"Desty Nova\"){.mw-redirect}, an eccentric\n[nanotechnology](/wiki/Nanotechnology \"Nanotechnology\") scientist who\nhas fled from Zalem. Desty Nova is the mastermind behind many of the\nenemies and trials that Alita faces, but does not make an actual\nappearance until more than two years into the story, although he is\nalluded to early on. Finally,\n[Kaos](/wiki/List_of_Battle_Angel_Alita_characters#Kaos \"List of Battle Angel Alita characters\"),\nDesty Nova\\'s son, a frail and troubled radio DJ with\n[psychometric](/wiki/Psychometry_(paranormal) \"Psychometry (paranormal)\")\npowers, also begins to play a crucial role after he comes in contact\nwith Alita. He broadcasts his popular radio show from the wastelands\noutside the Scrapyard, staying away from the increasing conflict between\nZalem and the rebel army\n[Barjack](/wiki/Barjack \"Barjack\"){.mw-redirect}.\n\n::: {.mw-heading .mw-heading2}\n## Production {#Production}\n\n[[\\[]{.mw-editsection-bracket}[edit](/w/index.php?title=Battle_Angel_Alita&action=edit&section=3 \"Edit section: Production\")[\\]]{.mw-editsection-bracket}]{.mw-editsection}\n:::\n\nAlita was originally a female cyborg police officer named Gally in an\nunpublished comic called\n*Rainmaker*.^[[\\[]{.cite-bracket}7[\\]]{.cite-bracket}](#cite_note-8)^\nPublishers at [Shueisha](/wiki/Shueisha \"Shueisha\") liked her and asked\nKishiro to make a new story with her as the main character. After he had\ncome up with the plot for a storyline he was commissioned to make it a\nlong-running\nseries.^[[\\[]{.cite-bracket}8[\\]]{.cite-bracket}](#cite_note-9)^\n\nBesides renaming *Gally* to *Alita*, older North American versions of\nthe manga also changed the city of *Zalem* (from Biblical Hebrew שָׁלֵם\n*šālēm*, \\\"peace\\\") to *Tiphares* (after\n*[Tiferet](/wiki/Tiferet_(Kabbalah) \"Tiferet (Kabbalah)\"){.mw-redirect}*).\nSince Kishiro also used the name *Jeru* (after\n*[Jerusalem](/wiki/Jerusalem \"Jerusalem\")*) for the facility atop\n*Zalem*, *Jeru* was renamed *Ketheres* in the translation (after\n*[Keter](/wiki/Keter \"Keter\")*). More recent versions reverted the\ncities\\' names back to Zalem and Jeru. To further develop the\n[Biblical](/wiki/Jewish_bible \"Jewish bible\"){.mw-redirect} theme in the\noriginal series, *Zalem*[\\']{.nowrap style=\"padding-left:0.1em;\"}s main\ncomputer was named *[Melchizedek](/wiki/Melchizedek \"Melchizedek\")*,\n\\\"the king of Salem\\\" and \\\"priest to the Most High\nGod\\\".^[[\\[]{.cite-bracket}9[\\]]{.cite-bracket}](#cite_note-10)^\n\n::: {.mw-heading .mw-heading2}\n## Media {#Media}\n\n[[\\[]{.mw-editsection-bracket}[edit](/w/index.php?title=Battle_Angel_Alita&action=edit&section=4 \"Edit section: Media\")[\\]]{.mw-editsection-bracket}]{.mw-editsection}\n:::\n\n::: {.mw-heading .mw-heading3}\n### Manga {#Manga}\n\n[[\\[]{.mw-editsection-bracket}[edit](/w/index.php?title=Battle_Angel_Alita&action=edit&section=5 \"Edit section: Manga\")[\\]]{.mw-editsection-bracket}]{.mw-editsection}\n:::\n\n::: {.hatnote .navigation-not-searchable role=\"note\"}\nMain article: [List of *Battle Angel Alita*\nchapters](/wiki/List_of_Battle_Angel_Alita_chapters \"List of Battle Angel Alita chapters\")\n:::\n\nThe manga was first published in\n[Shueisha](/wiki/Shueisha \"Shueisha\")\\'s *[Business\nJump](/wiki/Business_Jump \"Business Jump\")* magazine. It was then\nserialized from 1990 to 1995 in nine\n[*[tankōbon](/wiki/Tank%C5%8Dbon \"Tankōbon\")*]{title=\"Japanese-language romanization\"}.\n[Yukito Kishiro](/wiki/Yukito_Kishiro \"Yukito Kishiro\") moved from\nShueisha to [Kodansha](/wiki/Kodansha \"Kodansha\") in August 2010. The\ncompany acquired the license rights to *Battle Angel\nAlita*.^[[\\[]{.cite-bracket}10[\\]]{.cite-bracket}](#cite_note-11)[[\\[]{.cite-bracket}11[\\]]{.cite-bracket}](#cite_note-12)^\nA 6-volume special edition titled *Gunnm: Complete Edition* was released\nin Japan from December 18, 1998, to August 18, 2000. The series was\nreleased in\n[B5](/wiki/Japanese_B-series_variant \"Japanese B-series variant\"){.mw-redirect}\nformat and contains the original story, but without the original ending,\nwhich was [retconned](/wiki/Retcon \"Retcon\"){.mw-redirect} later in 2000\nby *[Battle Angel Alita: Last\nOrder](/wiki/Battle_Angel_Alita:_Last_Order \"Battle Angel Alita: Last Order\")*.\nAlso included are rough sketches, a timeline and the first three *Battle\nAngel Alita: Holy Night & Other Stories* short stories. From October 5\nto November 16, 2016, [Kodansha](/wiki/Kodansha \"Kodansha\") republished\n*Gunnm* in three volumes in [B5\nformat](/wiki/Paper_size#Japanese_B-series_variant \"Paper size\").^[[\\[]{.cite-bracket}12[\\]]{.cite-bracket}](#cite_note-13)[[\\[]{.cite-bracket}13[\\]]{.cite-bracket}](#cite_note-14)^\nIt was later reprinted in [A5\nformat](/wiki/Paper_size#A_series \"Paper size\") in five volumes from\nNovember 21, 2018, to February 22,\n2019.^[[\\[]{.cite-bracket}14[\\]]{.cite-bracket}](#cite_note-15)[[\\[]{.cite-bracket}15[\\]]{.cite-bracket}](#cite_note-16)^\n\nA spin-off series titled *[Ashen\nVictor](/wiki/Ashen_Victor \"Ashen Victor\")*[\n([[灰者]{lang=\"ja\"}]{title=\"Japanese-language text\"},\n[*Haisha*]{title=\"Hepburn transliteration\"})]{style=\"font-weight: normal\"}\nwas published in *[Ultra Jump](/wiki/Ultra_Jump \"Ultra Jump\")* from\nSeptember 1995 to July 1996 issues. It was released in a single volume\non June 24, 1998.\n\nA spin-off series titled *Battle Angel Alita: Holy Night & Other\nStories*[ ([[銃夢外伝]{lang=\"ja\"}]{title=\"Japanese-language text\"},\n[*Ganmu\nGaiden*]{title=\"Hepburn transliteration\"})]{style=\"font-weight: normal\"}\nwas published in *[Ultra Jump](/wiki/Ultra_Jump \"Ultra Jump\")* from\nJanuary 24, 1997, to December 19, 2006. It was released in a single\nvolume on December 19, 2007. It is composed of four short [side\nstories](/wiki/Side_story \"Side story\"){.mw-redirect}: \\\"Holy Night\\\",\n\\\"Sonic Finger\\\", \\\"Hometown\\\" and \\\"Barjack Rhapsody\\\".\n\nIn North America, [Viz Media](/wiki/Viz_Media \"Viz Media\") originally\nreleased the story in a 25-page comic book, after which it followed the\nsame volume format as its Japanese counterpart. vector-page-toolbar-container\n::: {#left-navigation}\n::: {#p-associated-pages .vector-menu .vector-menu-tabs .mw-portlet .mw-portlet-associated-pages}\n--\n## Plot {#Plot}\n\n[[\\[]{.mw-editsection-bracket}[edit](/w/index.php?title=Battle_Angel_Alita&action=edit&section=1 \"Edit section: Plot\")[\\]]{.mw-editsection-bracket}]{.mw-editsection}\n:::\n\n*Battle Angel Alita* tells the story of\n[Alita](/wiki/Alita_(Battle_Angel_Alita) \"Alita (Battle Angel Alita)\"),\nan [amnesiac](/wiki/Amnesia \"Amnesia\") female\n[cyborg](/wiki/Cyborg \"Cyborg\"). Her intact head and chest, in\n[suspended animation](/wiki/Suspended_animation \"Suspended animation\"),\nare found by cyber medic expert Daisuke Ido in the local garbage dump.\nIdo manages to revive her, and finding she has lost her memory, names\nher Alita after his recently deceased cat. The rebuilt Alita soon\ndiscovers that she instinctively remembers the legendary martial art,\nPanzer Kunst, although she does not recall anything else. Alita uses her\nPanzer Kunst to first become a [bounty\nhunter](/wiki/Bounty_hunter \"Bounty hunter\"), killing cyborg criminals\nin the Scrapyard, and then as a star player in the brutal\n[gladiator](/wiki/Gladiator \"Gladiator\") sport of Motorball. While in\ncombat, Alita awakens memories of her earlier life on Mars. She becomes\ninvolved with the floating city of Zalem (Tiphares in some older\ntranslations) as one of their agents and is sent to hunt down criminals.\nForemost is the mad genius Desty Nova, who has a complex, ever-changing\nrelationship with\nAlita.^[[\\[]{.cite-bracket}5[\\]]{.cite-bracket}](#cite_note-6)^\n\nThe futuristic [dystopian](/wiki/Dystopian \"Dystopian\"){.mw-redirect}\nworld of *Battle Angel Alita* revolves around the city of Scrapyard\n(Kuzutetsu in the Japanese and various other versions), which has grown\nup around a massive scrap heap that rains down from Zalem. Ground\ndwellers have no access to Zalem and are forced to make a living in the\nsprawl below. Many are heavily modified by cybernetics to better cope\nwith their hard life.\n\nZalem exploits the Scrapyard and surrounding farms, paying bounty\nhunters (called Hunter-Warriors) to hunt criminals and arranging violent\nsports to keep the population entertained. Massive tubes connect the\nScrapyard to Zalem, and the city uses robots for carrying out errands\nand providing security on the ground. Occasionally, Zalemites (such as\nDaisuke Ido and Desty Nova) are exiled and sent to the ground. Aside\nfrom the robots and exiles, there is little contact between the two\ncities.\n\nThe story takes place in the former United States. According to a map,\nprinted in the eighth volume, Scrapyard/Zalem is near [Kansas City,\nMissouri](/wiki/Kansas_City,_Missouri \"Kansas City, Missouri\"), and the\nNecropolis is [Colorado Springs,\nColorado](/wiki/Colorado_Springs,_Colorado \"Colorado Springs, Colorado\").\nRadio KAOS is at [Dallas,\nTexas](/wiki/Dallas,_Texas \"Dallas, Texas\"){.mw-redirect}. Figure\\'s\ncoastal hometown is [Alhambra,\nCalifornia](/wiki/Alhambra,_California \"Alhambra, California\"). Desty\nNova\\'s Granite Inn is built out of a military\nbase---[NORAD](/wiki/NORAD \"NORAD\") at [Cheyenne Mountain\nComplex](/wiki/Cheyenne_Mountain_Complex \"Cheyenne Mountain Complex\"),\n[Colorado](/wiki/Colorado \"Colorado\").^[[\\[]{.cite-bracket}6[\\]]{.cite-bracket}](#cite_note-kudoslist-7)^\n\n*Battle Angel Alita* is eventually revealed to take place in the 26th\ncentury. The sequel *Battle Angel Alita: Last Order* introduces a\n[calendar era](/wiki/Calendar_era \"Calendar era\") called \\\"Era\n[Sputnik](/wiki/Sputnik_1 \"Sputnik 1\")\\\" which has an\n[epoch](/wiki/Epoch_(reference_date) \"Epoch (reference date)\"){.mw-redirect}\nof AD 1957. The original *Battle Angel Alita* series begins in ES 577\n(AD 2533) and ends in ES 590 (AD 2546), *Battle Angel Alita: Last Order*\nis mostly set roughly in ES 591 (AD 2547), and *Battle Angel Alita: Mars\nChronicle* alternates between ES 373--374 (AD 2329--2330) and ES 594 (AD\n2550).\n\n::: {.mw-heading .mw-heading2}\n## Characters {#Characters}\n\n[[\\[]{.mw-editsection-bracket}[edit](/w/index.php?title=Battle_Angel_Alita&action=edit&section=2 \"Edit section: Characters\")[\\]]{.mw-editsection-bracket}]{.mw-editsection}\n:::\n\n::: {.hatnote .navigation-not-searchable role=\"note\"}\nMain article: [List of *Battle Angel Alita*\ncharacters](/wiki/List_of_Battle_Angel_Alita_characters \"List of Battle Angel Alita characters\")\n:::\n\n*Battle Angel Alita* features a diverse cast of characters, many of whom\nshift in and out of focus as the story progresses. Some are never to be\nseen again following the conclusion of a story arc, while others make\nrecurring appearances. The one character who remains a constant\nthroughout is\n[Alita](/wiki/Alita_(Battle_Angel_Alita) \"Alita (Battle Angel Alita)\"),\nthe [protagonist](/wiki/Protagonist \"Protagonist\") and title character,\na young cyborg with amnesia struggling to uncover her forgotten past\nthrough the only thing she remembers from it: by fighting. Early on in\nthe story, [Daisuke\nIdo](/wiki/List_of_Battle_Angel_Alita_characters#Daisuke_Ido \"List of Battle Angel Alita characters\"),\na [bounty-hunting](/wiki/Bounty_hunter \"Bounty hunter\") cybernetic\ndoctor who finds and revives Alita, plays a major role as well, but\nmidway the focus begins to increasingly shift to [Desty\nNova](/wiki/Desty_Nova \"Desty Nova\"){.mw-redirect}, an eccentric\n[nanotechnology](/wiki/Nanotechnology \"Nanotechnology\") scientist who\nhas fled from Zalem. Desty Nova is the mastermind behind many of the\nenemies and trials that Alita faces, but does not make an actual\nappearance until more than two years into the story, although he is\nalluded to early on. Finally,\n[Kaos](/wiki/List_of_Battle_Angel_Alita_characters#Kaos \"List of Battle Angel Alita characters\"),\nDesty Nova\\'s son, a frail and troubled radio DJ with\n[psychometric](/wiki/Psychometry_(paranormal) \"Psychometry (paranormal)\")\npowers, also begins to play a crucial role after he comes in contact\nwith Alita. He broadcasts his popular radio show from the wastelands\noutside the Scrapyard, staying away from the increasing conflict between\nZalem and the rebel army\n[Barjack](/wiki/Barjack \"Barjack\"){.mw-redirect}.\n\n::: {.mw-heading .mw-heading2}\n## Production {#Production}\n\n[[\\[]{.mw-editsection-bracket}[edit](/w/index.php?title=Battle_Angel_Alita&action=edit&section=3 \"Edit section: Production\")[\\]]{.mw-editsection-bracket}]{.mw-editsection}\n:::\n\nAlita was originally a female cyborg police officer named Gally in an\nunpublished comic called\n*Rainmaker*.^[[\\[]{.cite-bracket}7[\\]]{.cite-bracket}](#cite_note-8)^\nPublishers at [Shueisha](/wiki/Shueisha \"Shueisha\") liked her and asked\nKishiro to make a new story with her as the main character. After he had\ncome up with the plot for a storyline he was commissioned to make it a\nlong-running\nseries.^[[\\[]{.cite-bracket}8[\\]]{.cite-bracket}](#cite_note-9)^\n\nBesides renaming *Gally* to *Alita*, older North American versions of\nthe manga also changed the city of *Zalem* (from Biblical Hebrew שָׁלֵם\n*šālēm*, \\\"peace\\\") to *Tiphares* (after\n*[Tiferet](/wiki/Tiferet_(Kabbalah) \"Tiferet (Kabbalah)\"){.mw-redirect}*).\nSince Kishiro also used the name *Jeru* (after\n*[Jerusalem](/wiki/Jerusalem \"Jerusalem\")*) for the facility atop\n*Zalem*, *Jeru* was renamed *Ketheres* in the translation (after\n*[Keter](/wiki/Keter \"Keter\")*). More recent versions reverted the\ncities\\' names back to Zalem and Jeru. To further develop the\n[Biblical](/wiki/Jewish_bible \"Jewish bible\"){.mw-redirect} theme in the\noriginal series, *Zalem*[\\']{.nowrap style=\"padding-left:0.1em;\"}s main\ncomputer was named *[Melchizedek](/wiki/Melchizedek \"Melchizedek\")*,\n\\\"the king of Salem\\\" and \\\"priest to the Most High\nGod\\\".^[[\\[]{.cite-bracket}9[\\]]{.cite-bracket}](#cite_note-10)^\n\n::: {.mw-heading .mw-heading2}\n## Media {#Media}\n\n[[\\[]{.mw-editsection-bracket}[edit](/w/index.php?title=Battle_Angel_Alita&action=edit&section=4 \"Edit section: Media\")[\\]]{.mw-editsection-bracket}]{.mw-editsection}\n:::\n\n::: {.mw-heading .mw-heading3}\n### Manga {#Manga}\n\n[[\\[]{.mw-editsection-bracket}[edit](/w/index.php?title=Battle_Angel_Alita&action=edit&section=5 \"Edit section: Manga\")[\\]]{.mw-editsection-bracket}]{.mw-editsection}\n:::\n\n::: {.hatnote .navigation-not-searchable role=\"note\"}\nMain article: [List of *Battle Angel Alita*\nchapters](/wiki/List_of_Battle_Angel_Alita_chapters \"List of Battle Angel Alita chapters\")\n:::\n\nThe manga was first published in\n[Shueisha](/wiki/Shueisha \"Shueisha\")\\'s *[Business\nJump](/wiki/Business_Jump \"Business Jump\")* magazine. In June 2010 it went on hiatus\nsince the [100th installment](/wiki/Phase_100 \"Phase 100\") due to a\ndisagreement between Kishiro and an editor at *Ultra Jump*. Along with a\nbandanna, his typical attire consists of a patterned tank top, jeans,\nand high boots with studded shins. Over this he usually wears a robe.\nThis was the same outfit he wore in the\n[Epilogue](/wiki/Battle_Angel_Alita_Epilogue \"Battle Angel Alita Epilogue\")\nwhen he visited [Ketheres Elyion]{.new\ntitle=\"Ketheres Elyion (page does not exist)\"\nuncrawlable-url=\"L3dpa2kvS2V0aGVyZXNfRWx5aW9uP2FjdGlvbj1lZGl0JnJlZGxpbms9MQ==\"}.\nAfter he returned to Alhambra, Figure was shown wearing a tank top and\nshorts and going barefoot. While normally clean-shaven, at the end of\n*Battle Angel Alita* Figure had let his facial hair grow out with slight\ntraces of scarring on his chin and neck. In *[Last\nOrder](/wiki/Last_Order \"Last Order\"){.mw-redirect}* he remains\nclean-shaven when appearing in Alita\\'s thoughts. After losing his right\nforearm in a fight with [Sechs](/wiki/Sechs \"Sechs\"), it was replaced\nwith a [cybernetic](/wiki/Cybernetic \"Cybernetic\"){.mw-redirect}\nforearm. This was destroyed when he attempted a strike against a tree\nand was replaced.\n\nAn illustration by [Yukito\nKishiro](/wiki/Yukito_Kishiro \"Yukito Kishiro\") for the 2003 *[Ultra\nJump](/wiki/Ultra_Jump \"Ultra Jump\")* calendar depicts Figure as having\nblack hair and being\ntanned.^[[\\[]{.cite-bracket}1[\\]]{.cite-bracket}](#cite_note-1)^ In\n*[Gunnm: Martian\nMemory](/wiki/Gunnm:_Martian_Memory \"Gunnm: Martian Memory\")*, he is\ndepicted as being light skinned and having black hair. He wears a light\nyellow bandanna, green patterned sleeveless shirt, jeans, and brown\nboots.\n\n### [Gallery]{#Gallery .mw-headline}[[\\[]{.mw-editsection-bracket}[![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyBjbGFzcz0id2RzLWljb24gd2RzLWljb24tdGlueSIgYXJpYS1oaWRkZW49InRydWUiIGZvY3VzYWJsZT0iZmFsc2UiPjx1c2UgeGxpbms6aHJlZj0iI3dkcy1pY29ucy1wZW5jaWwtdGlueSI+PC91c2U+PC9zdmc+){.wds-icon .wds-icon-tiny}](https://battleangel.fandom.com/wiki/Figure_Four?veaction=edit&section=2 \"Edit section: Gallery\"){.mw-editsection-visualeditor tracking-label=\"edit-section-anon\" data-action=\"edit-section\" aria-label=\"Edit section: Gallery\"}[\\]]{.mw-editsection-bracket}]{.mw-editsection}\n\n--\nuncrawlable-url=\"L3dpa2kvS29wcG8/YWN0aW9uPWVkaXQmcmVkbGluaz0x\"} gives\nFigure a quiet confidence, pride, and unwillingness to back down from\nfights. He seems to get into these by refusing to back down from the\nchallenges of his [cyborg](/wiki/Cyborg \"Cyborg\") opponents who have\ntended to dismiss him because he has no cybernetic enhancements. This\nalso inspired him to have a goal of defeating 1,000 cyborg opponents in\ncombat.^[[\\[]{.cite-bracket}3[\\]]{.cite-bracket}](#cite_note-3)^\n\nFigure has a strong sense of justice, challenging Alita to a fight when\nshe revealed that she was going to abandon him and\n[Yolg](/wiki/Yolg \"Yolg\") in the desert. Although she kept defeating\nhim, he would not give up until he was knocked out, and even after\nreviving, yelled out that she was running out on their fight even when\nshe was long gone. Despite this treatment, Figure values sticking by his\nfriends even at the risk of his own life, coming to the aid of Yolg, and\nlater Alita herself.\n\n## [Relationships]{#Relationships .mw-headline}[[\\[]{.mw-editsection-bracket}[![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyBjbGFzcz0id2RzLWljb24gd2RzLWljb24tdGlueSIgYXJpYS1oaWRkZW49InRydWUiIGZvY3VzYWJsZT0iZmFsc2UiPjx1c2UgeGxpbms6aHJlZj0iI3dkcy1pY29ucy1wZW5jaWwtdGlueSI+PC91c2U+PC9zdmc+){.wds-icon .wds-icon-tiny}](https://battleangel.fandom.com/wiki/Figure_Four?veaction=edit&section=4 \"Edit section: Relationships\"){.mw-editsection-visualeditor tracking-label=\"edit-section-anon\" data-action=\"edit-section\" aria-label=\"Edit section: Relationships\"}[\\]]{.mw-editsection-bracket}]{.mw-editsection}\n\n### [[Alita](/wiki/Alita \"Alita\")]{#Alita .mw-headline}[[\\[]{.mw-editsection-bracket}[![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyBjbGFzcz0id2RzLWljb24gd2RzLWljb24tdGlueSIgYXJpYS1oaWRkZW49InRydWUiIGZvY3VzYWJsZT0iZmFsc2UiPjx1c2UgeGxpbms6aHJlZj0iI3dkcy1pY29ucy1wZW5jaWwtdGlueSI+PC91c2U+PC9zdmc+){.wds-icon .wds-icon-tiny}](https://battleangel.fandom.com/wiki/Figure_Four?veaction=edit&section=5 \"Edit section: Alita\"){.mw-editsection-visualeditor tracking-label=\"edit-section-anon\" data-action=\"edit-section\" aria-label=\"Edit section: Alita\"}[\\]]{.mw-editsection-bracket}]{.mw-editsection}\n\nAlita\\'s air of mystery at first intrigued Figure, and he was not afraid\nto approach her despite Yolg\\'s warnings. It appeared that he genuinely\nwanted to get to know her better, but became frustrated by her behavior\nas a member of [TUNED](/wiki/TUNED \"TUNED\"). She at first saved him and\nYolg by disabling their [rent-a-guns](/wiki/Rent-a-gun \"Rent-a-gun\"),\nthen by driving them away from [Factory Train 12]{.new\ntitle=\"Factory Train 12 (page does not exist)\"\nuncrawlable-url=\"L3dpa2kvRmFjdG9yeV9UcmFpbl8xMj9hY3Rpb249ZWRpdCZyZWRsaW5rPTE=\"}\nbefore its reactor exploded. She then abandoned them temporarily to\ncontinue her mission, but returned for them after being warned by\n[Bigott Eizenburg](/wiki/Bigott_Eizenburg \"Bigott Eizenburg\") about a\npowerful tornado that the explosion triggered.\n\nAfter being dropped by the tornado in the [Boiling Metal Battalion\nbase](/wiki/Boiling_Metal_Battalion_base \"Boiling Metal Battalion base\"),\nFigure tried to teach Alita a lesson by suspending her off a high-rise.\nAlthough she later opened up to him and revealed her mission as a TUNED\nagent after he shimmied down to talk to her, he angered her by taunting\nher with some [corned\nbeef](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/corned_beef \"wikipedia:corned beef\"){.extiw},\ncausing her to kick him and catch him in time to prevent him from\nfalling. When the Boiling Metal ceased shelling the city and began to\nadvance, Alita was quickly enraged at Yolg\\'s fear of fighting and was\nabout to\n[pistol-whip](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pistol-whipping \"wikipedia:Pistol-whipping\"){.extiw}\nhim when Figure intervened, questioning her bloodlust. After Alita\ndeclared how much she loved fighting, Figure replied that he enjoyed it\nhimself as well, \\\"better than getting three meals a day\\\", but that he\nhated wars and \\\"girls that fight in\nthem.\\\"^[[\\[]{.cite-bracket}2[\\]]{.cite-bracket}](#cite_note-Battle_33-2)^\nThis caused Alita to pause and start to consider Figure differently.\nThis was further reinforced when he intervened in her fight with the\nBoiling Metal by commandeering a minigun and laying down covering fire.\nWhen Figure was apparently killed by the battalion, Alita realized how\nmuch she cared about him and tried to attack [Colonel\nBozzle](/wiki/Colonel_Bozzle \"Colonel Bozzle\"){.mw-redirect} in a rage,\nbut he blew off her legs below the knees using her own\n[rifle](/wiki/TUNED_rifle \"TUNED rifle\"). Figure again saved Alita again\nby killing [Knucklehead](/wiki/Knucklehead \"Knucklehead\") when he was\nabout to duel her, and she revealed that she liked him when she welcomed\nhis kiss. After the death of Yolg, the two set off for Alhambra,\npersisting when they ran out of gas and water, although Figure had to\ncarry Alita because she could not walk. When she told him he could leave\nher behind, he refused, confessing that he was free to carry the woman\nhe had fallen for. They were about to die in the middle of the desert\nwhen Bigott manipulated the weather patterns and had the skies open up\nand pour down water and fish on them. After arriving at Alhambra, Alita\npromised to return to Figure while he waited for her, telling him not to\ncheat on her.\n\n<figure class=\"thumb show-info-icon\" typeof=\"mw:File/Thumb\"\nstyle=\"width: 180px\">\n<a\nhref=\"https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/battleangel/images/1/1f/BAA09_253_Alita_%26_Figure.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20110307203345\"\nclass=\"mw-file-description image\"><img\nsrc=\"data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D\"\nclass=\"thumbimage lazyload\" decoding=\"async\" loading=\"lazy\"\ndata-image-name=\"BAA09 253 Alita &amp; Five years after Alita fused with the\n[sky hook]{.new title=\"Sky hook (page does not exist)\"\nuncrawlable-url=\"L3dpa2kvU2t5X2hvb2s/YWN0aW9uPWVkaXQmcmVkbGluaz0x\"} and\nformed the [Life-Tree]{.new title=\"Life-Tree (page does not exist)\"\nuncrawlable-url=\"L3dpa2kvTGlmZS1UcmVlP2FjdGlvbj1lZGl0JnJlZGxpbms9MQ==\"}\nto save [Tiphares](/wiki/Tiphares \"Tiphares\"){.mw-redirect} and the\n[Scrapyard](/wiki/Scrapyard \"Scrapyard\"), Figure journeyed to [Ketheres\nElyion]{.new title=\"Ketheres Elyion (page does not exist)\"\nuncrawlable-url=\"L3dpa2kvS2V0aGVyZXNfRWx5aW9uP2FjdGlvbj1lZGl0JnJlZGxpbms9MQ==\"}\nwhere he was found by [Koyomi](/wiki/Koyomi \"Koyomi\"){.mw-redirect}.\nWhen she told him that Alita was dead, he violently refused to believe\nher and after encountering a senile [Desty\nNova](/wiki/Desty_Nova \"Desty Nova\"), demanded to know where Alita was.\nNova lead them to a chamber inside the trunk of the Life-Tree where a\ngiant bulb was growing. Seeing something inside the bulb, Figure broke\nit and was reunited with Alita, who had been regenerated in a\n[human](/wiki/Human \"Human\") body in the manga\\'s original ending.\n\nIn *[Last Order](/wiki/Last_Order \"Last Order\"){.mw-redirect},* it was\nshown that Figure never forgot about her and was still waiting for Alita\nto return; he even announced his intention to marry Alita despite his\nmaster [Tauro Four]{.new title=\"Tauro Four (page does not exist)\"\nuncrawlable-url=\"L3dpa2kvVGF1cm9fRm91cj9hY3Rpb249ZWRpdCZyZWRsaW5rPTE=\"}\\'s\ndoubts. After discovering a [TUNED\npistol](/wiki/TUNED_pistol \"TUNED pistol\") being sold by a caravan, he\nsets off to discover what has happened to Alita.\n\n### [[Yolg](/wiki/Yolg \"Yolg\")]{#Yolg Up to his fight with Alita, he had beaten\n35 cyborgs in combat with the ultimate aim of beating a thousand because\nof his techniques. These victories were also due in part to the fact\nthat his opponents had not been as skilled fighters and tend to\nunderestimate him because he had no cyborg enhancements. that he was raised by his master [Tauro Four]{.new\ntitle=\"Tauro Four (page does not exist)\"\nuncrawlable-url=\"L3dpa2kvVGF1cm9fRm91cj9hY3Rpb249ZWRpdCZyZWRsaW5rPTE=\"}\nin [Alhambra](/wiki/Alhambra \"Alhambra\"). He grew up to be a fisherman\nbut also became a practitioner of the anti-cyborg martial art known as\n[Koppo]{.new title=\"Koppo (page does not exist)\"\nuncrawlable-url=\"L3dpa2kvS29wcG8/YWN0aW9uPWVkaXQmcmVkbGluaz0x\"}. As a\nchild, he learned from [his village](/wiki/Alhambra \"Alhambra\")\\'s\nrainmaker a song that would summon a rainstorm when played and would\npractice it on a harmonica he owned or had in his family\\'s possession.\nAs an adult, he decided to leave Alhambra and would travel for a year\nthroughout the Badlands and the [Scrapyard](/wiki/Scrapyard \"Scrapyard\")\nin order to see [Tiphares](/wiki/Tiphares \"Tiphares\"){.mw-redirect}.\n\n## [Plot]{#Plot eventually\nsigned up to be a [rail\nmercenary](/wiki/Rail_mercenary \"Rail mercenary\") on [Factory Train\n12]{.new title=\"Factory Train 12 (page does not exist)\"\nuncrawlable-url=\"L3dpa2kvRmFjdG9yeV9UcmFpbl8xMj9hY3Rpb249ZWRpdCZyZWRsaW5rPTE=\"}.\nDuring the journey he befriended [Yolg](/wiki/Yolg \"Yolg\"), a fellow\nrail mercenary. As the train travelled through the Badlands, he heard a\nharmonica playing and came across [Alita](/wiki/Alita \"Alita\") playing\nit atop the train. Despite Yolg\\'s warnings, he became intrigued by her\nand boldly took the harmonica from her hands. While his efforts to play\nfailed, he was able to get introduced to her. Although when he noticed\nAlita\\'s [rifle](/wiki/TUNED_rifle \"TUNED rifle\") as being different\nfrom the other guns given to the mercenaries, she warned him to stay\naway from her. The appearance of\n[Knucklehead](/wiki/Knucklehead \"Knucklehead\")'s squad on\n[Gabriel](/wiki/Gabriel \"Gabriel\"){.mw-redirect}\\'s radar warned Alita\nabout the pending attack, which she focused on to Figure\\'s puzzlement.\nWhen the squad attacked the train and it was derailed, Figure and Yolg\nwere thrown from the train, although the latter\\'s leg was broken.\nFigure was able to save Yolg from Knucklehead himself, and was in turn\nsaved by Alita who used his shoulder to brace her rifle. She then threw\nthem both at the train to prevent their\n[rent-a-gun](/wiki/Rent-a-gun \"Rent-a-gun\") packs from detonating. After\nthe nuclear reactor began to melt down, Figure thought that they were\nfinished as the rent-a-gun computer had been damaged by the derailment,\nbut he and Yolg were again rescued by Alita, who was able to hack into\nand remove their packs. She took them away in a [buggy]{.new\ntitle=\"Buggy (page does not exist)\"\nuncrawlable-url=\"L3dpa2kvQnVnZ3k/YWN0aW9uPWVkaXQmcmVkbGluaz0x\"} from the\ntrain before the reactor exploded. That night Figure challenged Alita to\na fight after learning that she planned to leave him and Yolg in the\nmiddle of the desert, but was soundly beaten by her. After leaving,\nAlita changed her mind when she learned from [Bigott\nEizenburg](/wiki/Bigott_Eizenburg \"Bigott Eizenburg\") that a massive\ntornado had been triggered by the nuclear explosion, and returned for\nFigure and Yolg.\n\nHowever their jeep got caught up in the tornado and wound up on the edge\nof a skyscraper. Figure was able to save them, but as payback for his\ntreatment by Alita, suspended her from the building. He later shimmied\ndown to have a talk with Alita. Although the two opened up to each\nother, Figure\\'s taunting set Alita off and she kicked him hard, making\nhim lose his grip on the rope he was hanging onto. After she managed to\ngrab him with her legs and threatened to drop him, the\n[Barjack](/wiki/Barjack \"Barjack\")\\'s [Boiling Metal\nBattalion](/wiki/Boiling_Metal_Battalion \"Boiling Metal Battalion\"),\nwhich had returned to their base, attacked. Alita saved Yolg and Figure\nwhen the building they were on was hit and collapsed. While hiding,\nFigure called into question Alita\\'s bloodlust and desire for battle,\nmaking her think about her motivations. As she fought the Barjack, he\ndecided to help her after realizing that she was less free than he was\nbecause she could not choose not to fight. He hijacked a Barjack vehicle\nmounting a [minigun]{.new title=\"Minigun (page does not exist)\"\nuncrawlable-url=\"L3dpa2kvTWluaWd1bj9hY3Rpb249ZWRpdCZyZWRsaW5rPTE=\"}\nafter the rest of the battalion arrived and had pinned down Alita,\nlaying down enough covering fire for her to go after Colonel\n[Bozzle](/wiki/Bozzle \"Bozzle\"), but Yolg's defection stopped her short.\nThe battalion then attacked Figure, apparently killing him when the\nbuilding behind him collapsed on him.\n\n<figure class=\"thumb show-info-icon\" typeof=\"mw:File/Thumb\"\nstyle=\"width: He managed to catch up to\nthe battalion when it had camped for the night and was able to save\nAlita from [Knucklehead](/wiki/Knucklehead \"Knucklehead\") when the\nlatter attempted to duel with her, after which he realized that Alita\nlikes him. After Bozzle was killed, Figure and Alita set off to\nAlhambra. Eventually they ran out of fuel for their jeep, and Figure\ncarried Alita on his back as her legs had been shot off below the knees\nby Bozzle. Although they ran out of water and her\n[TUNED](/wiki/TUNED \"TUNED\") body overheated, Figure refused to abandon\nher, admitting that he had fallen in love with her. They were saved by a\ndeluge of rain and fish, a result of Bigott having manipulated the\nweather patterns to save Alita. Figure and Alita eventually reached\nAlhambra, where Figure returned to his previous life as a fisherman.\nAlita promised to return to him when her mission of apprehending [Desty\nNova](/wiki/Desty_Nova \"Desty Nova\") was finished.\n\nFigure was later shown listening to the last broadcast of [Radio\nK.A.O.S.](/wiki/Radio_K.A.O.S. \"Radio K.A.O.S.\") while preparing a\nharpoon for\nfishing.^[[\\[]{.cite-bracket}5[\\]]{.cite-bracket}](#cite_note-5)^ He\nalso appeared in Alita\\'s thoughts during her battle with\nAR-2^[[\\[]{.cite-bracket}6[\\]]{.cite-bracket}](#cite_note-6)^ and when\nBigott offered to let her go after she apprehended\nNova.^[[\\[]{.cite-bracket}7[\\]]{.cite-bracket}](#cite_note-7)^\n\n#### [Original manga ending]{#Original_manga_ending .mw-headline}[[\\[]{.mw-editsection-bracket}[![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyBjbGFzcz0id2RzLWljb24gd2RzLWljb24tdGlueSIgYXJpYS1oaWRkZW49InRydWUiIGZvY3VzYWJsZT0iZmFsc2UiPjx1c2UgeGxpbms6aHJlZj0iI3dkcy1pY29ucy1wZW5jaWwtdGlueSI+PC91c2U+PC9zdmc+){.wds-icon .wds-icon-tiny}](https://battleangel.fandom.com/wiki/Figure_Four?veaction=edit&section=13 \"Edit section: Original manga ending\"){.mw-editsection-visualeditor tracking-label=\"edit-section-anon\" data-action=\"edit-section\" aria-label=\"Edit section: Original manga ending\"}[\\]]{.mw-editsection-bracket}]{.mw-editsection}\n\nJust before she transformed herself into the [Tree of Life]{.new\ntitle=\"Tree of Life (page does not exist)\"\nuncrawlable-url=\"L3dpa2kvVHJlZV9vZl9MaWZlP2FjdGlvbj1lZGl0JnJlZGxpbms9MQ==\"},\nAlita was able to use her Accelerator to travel to Alhambra and see him\nfor the last time as he prepared to fish before returning to Tiphares\nand ascending to the sky hook to fuse with the docking bolt and save\n[Tiphares](/wiki/Tiphares \"Tiphares\"){.mw-redirect} and the\n[Scrapyard](/wiki/Scrapyard \"Scrapyard\"). Shortly after, a senile Nova was found.\nFigure grabbed him and asked him about Alita, prompting him to lead them\ninto the trunk of the Tree of Life's and to a chamber where a large bulb\nwas suspended. When they took a break, Tauro expressed his doubts about\nFigure wanting to marry Alita but the latter defended Alita and\ndisregarded Tauro\\'s statement that his parents would have been\ndisappointed in him. With the arrival of a trading caravan, Figure came\nacross a TUNED pistol that the dealer related had been taken from the\nbody of the \\\"Angel of Death\\\". As he was unaware of the [TUNED AR\nSeries 2](/wiki/TUNED_AR_Series_2 \"TUNED AR Series 2\"), Figure believed\nthis to be Alita and that night packed up to go in search of her. .pi-border-color source=\"debut\"}\n### **Debut** {#debut .pi-data-label .pi-secondary-font}\n\n::: {.pi-data-value .pi-font}\n[Battle 31](/wiki/Battle_31 \"Battle 31\")\n:::\n:::\n\n**Figure Four**, known in Japan as **Fogir Fore**[\n([フォギア・フォア]{.t_nihongo_kanji lang=\"ja\"}[,]{.t_nihongo_comma\nstyle=\"display:none\"} *[Fogia\nFoa]{.t_nihongo_romaji}*[^[[?]{.t_nihongo_icon\nstyle=\"color:#00e;font:bold 80% sans-serif;text-decoration:none;padding:0 .1em;\"}](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Help:Japanese \"wikipedia:Help:Japanese\"){.extiw}^]{.t_nihongo_help})]{style=\"font-weight: normal\"},\nis a [human](/wiki/Human \"Human\") [martial artist]{.new\ntitle=\"Martial artist (page does not exist)\"\nuncrawlable-url=\"L3dpa2kvTWFydGlhbF9hcnRpc3Q/YWN0aW9uPWVkaXQmcmVkbGluaz0x\"}\nand fisherman from the coastal village of\n[Alhambra](/wiki/Alhambra \"Alhambra\"). Named after the [figure-four\ngrappling\nhold](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure-four_(grappling_hold) \"wikipedia:Figure-four (grappling hold)\"){.extiw}\nand known for his mastery of [anti-cyber martial arts]{.new\ntitle=\"Anti-cyber martial arts (page does not exist)\"\nuncrawlable-url=\"L3dpa2kvQW50aS1jeWJlcl9tYXJ0aWFsX2FydHM/YWN0aW9uPWVkaXQmcmVkbGluaz0x\"},\nhe became the second man who [Alita](/wiki/Alita \"Alita\") fell in love\nwith.\n\n::: {#toc .toc role=\"navigation\" aria-labelledby=\"mw-toc-heading\"}\n::: {.toctitle lang=\"en\" dir=\"ltr\"}\n## Contents {#mw-toc-heading}\n\n[]{.toctogglespan}\n:::\n\n-   [[1]{.tocnumber} [Appearance]{.toctext}](#Appearance)\n    - Along with a\nbandanna, his typical attire consists of a patterned tank top, jeans,\nand high boots with studded shins. Over this he usually wears a robe.\nThis was the same outfit he wore in the\n[Epilogue](/wiki/Battle_Angel_Alita_Epilogue \"Battle Angel Alita Epilogue\")\nwhen he visited [Ketheres Elyion]{.new\ntitle=\"Ketheres Elyion (page does not exist)\"\nuncrawlable-url=\"L3dpa2kvS2V0aGVyZXNfRWx5aW9uP2FjdGlvbj1lZGl0JnJlZGxpbms9MQ==\"}.\nAfter he returned to Alhambra, Figure was shown wearing a tank top and\nshorts and going barefoot. While normally clean-shaven, at the end of\n*Battle Angel Alita* Figure had let his facial hair grow out with slight\ntraces of scarring on his chin and neck. In *[Last\nOrder](/wiki/Last_Order \"Last Order\"){.mw-redirect}* he remains\nclean-shaven when appearing in Alita\\'s thoughts. After losing his right\nforearm in a fight with [Sechs](/wiki/Sechs \"Sechs\"), it was replaced\nwith a [cybernetic](/wiki/Cybernetic \"Cybernetic\"){.mw-redirect}\nforearm. This was destroyed when he attempted a strike against a tree\nand was replaced.\n\nAn illustration by [Yukito\nKishiro](/wiki/Yukito_Kishiro \"Yukito Kishiro\") for the 2003 *[Ultra\nJump](/wiki/Ultra_Jump \"Ultra Jump\")* calendar depicts Figure as having\nblack hair and being\ntanned.^[[\\[]{.cite-bracket}1[\\]]{.cite-bracket}](#cite_note-1)^ In\n*[Gunnm: Martian\nMemory](/wiki/Gunnm:_Martian_Memory \"Gunnm: Martian Memory\")*, he is\ndepicted as being light skinned and having black hair. He wears a light\nyellow bandanna, green patterned sleeveless shirt, jeans, and brown\nboots.\n\n### [Gallery]{#Gallery .mw-headline}[[\\[]{.mw-editsection-bracket}[![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyBjbGFzcz0id2RzLWljb24gd2RzLWljb24tdGlueSIgYXJpYS1oaWRkZW49InRydWUiIGZvY3VzYWJsZT0iZmFsc2UiPjx1c2UgeGxpbms6aHJlZj0iI3dkcy1pY29ucy1wZW5jaWwtdGlueSI+PC91c2U+PC9zdmc+){.wds-icon .wds-icon-tiny}](https://battleangel.fandom.com/wiki/Figure_Four?veaction=edit&section=2 \"Edit section: Gallery\"){.mw-editsection-visualeditor tracking-label=\"edit-section-anon\" data-action=\"edit-section\" aria-label=\"Edit section: Gallery\"}[\\]]{.mw-editsection-bracket}]{.mw-editsection}\n\n--\nuncrawlable-url=\"L3dpa2kvS29wcG8/YWN0aW9uPWVkaXQmcmVkbGluaz0x\"} gives\nFigure a quiet confidence, pride, and unwillingness to back down from\nfights. He seems to get into these by refusing to back down from the\nchallenges of his [cyborg](/wiki/Cyborg \"Cyborg\") opponents who have\ntended to dismiss him because he has no cybernetic enhancements. This\nalso inspired him to have a goal of defeating 1,000 cyborg opponents in\ncombat.^[[\\[]{.cite-bracket}3[\\]]{.cite-bracket}](#cite_note-3)^\n\nFigure has a strong sense of justice, challenging Alita to a fight when\nshe revealed that she was going to abandon him and\n[Yolg](/wiki/Yolg \"Yolg\") in the desert. Although she kept defeating\nhim, he would not give up until he was knocked out, and even after\nreviving, yelled out that she was running out on their fight even when\nshe was long gone. Despite this treatment, Figure values sticking by his\nfriends even at the risk of his own life, coming to the aid of Yolg, and\nlater Alita herself.\n\n## [Relationships]{#Relationships .mw-headline}[[\\[]{.mw-editsection-bracket}[![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyBjbGFzcz0id2RzLWljb24gd2RzLWljb24tdGlueSIgYXJpYS1oaWRkZW49InRydWUiIGZvY3VzYWJsZT0iZmFsc2UiPjx1c2UgeGxpbms6aHJlZj0iI3dkcy1pY29ucy1wZW5jaWwtdGlueSI+PC91c2U+PC9zdmc+){.wds-icon .wds-icon-tiny}](https://battleangel.fandom.com/wiki/Figure_Four?veaction=edit&section=4 \"Edit section: Relationships\"){.mw-editsection-visualeditor tracking-label=\"edit-section-anon\" data-action=\"edit-section\" aria-label=\"Edit section: Relationships\"}[\\]]{.mw-editsection-bracket}]{.mw-editsection}\n\n### [[Alita](/wiki/Alita \"Alita\")]{#Alita .mw-headline}[[\\[]{.mw-editsection-bracket}[![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyBjbGFzcz0id2RzLWljb24gd2RzLWljb24tdGlueSIgYXJpYS1oaWRkZW49InRydWUiIGZvY3VzYWJsZT0iZmFsc2UiPjx1c2UgeGxpbms6aHJlZj0iI3dkcy1pY29ucy1wZW5jaWwtdGlueSI+PC91c2U+PC9zdmc+){.wds-icon .wds-icon-tiny}](https://battleangel.fandom.com/wiki/Figure_Four?veaction=edit&section=5 \"Edit section: Alita\"){.mw-editsection-visualeditor tracking-label=\"edit-section-anon\" data-action=\"edit-section\" aria-label=\"Edit section: Alita\"}[\\]]{.mw-editsection-bracket}]{.mw-editsection}\n\nAlita\\'s air of mystery at first intrigued Figure, and he was not afraid\nto approach her despite Yolg\\'s warnings. It appeared that he genuinely\nwanted to get to know her better, but became frustrated by her behavior\nas a member of [TUNED](/wiki/TUNED \"TUNED\"). She at first saved him and\nYolg by disabling their [rent-a-guns](/wiki/Rent-a-gun \"Rent-a-gun\"),\nthen by driving them away from [Factory Train 12]{.new\ntitle=\"Factory Train 12 (page does not exist)\"\nuncrawlable-url=\"L3dpa2kvRmFjdG9yeV9UcmFpbl8xMj9hY3Rpb249ZWRpdCZyZWRsaW5rPTE=\"}\nbefore its reactor exploded. She then abandoned them temporarily to\ncontinue her mission, but returned for them after being warned by\n[Bigott Eizenburg](/wiki/Bigott_Eizenburg \"Bigott Eizenburg\") about a\npowerful tornado that the explosion triggered.\n\nAfter being dropped by the tornado in the [Boiling Metal Battalion\nbase](/wiki/Boiling_Metal_Battalion_base \"Boiling Metal Battalion base\"),\nFigure tried to teach Alita a lesson by suspending her off a high-rise.\nAlthough she later opened up to him and revealed her mission as a TUNED\nagent after he shimmied down to talk to her, he angered her by taunting\nher with some [corned\nbeef](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/corned_beef \"wikipedia:corned beef\"){.extiw},\ncausing her to kick him and catch him in time to prevent him from\nfalling. When the Boiling Metal ceased shelling the city and began to\nadvance, Alita was quickly enraged at Yolg\\'s fear of fighting and was\nabout to\n[pistol-whip](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pistol-whipping \"wikipedia:Pistol-whipping\"){.extiw}\nhim when Figure intervened, questioning her bloodlust. After Alita\ndeclared how much she loved fighting, Figure replied that he enjoyed it\nhimself as well, \\\"better than getting three meals a day\\\", but that he\nhated wars and \\\"girls that fight in\nthem.\\\"^[[\\[]{.cite-bracket}2[\\]]{.cite-bracket}](#cite_note-Battle_33-2)^\nThis caused Alita to pause and start to consider Figure differently.\nThis was further reinforced when he intervened in her fight with the\nBoiling Metal by commandeering a minigun and laying down covering fire.\nWhen Figure was apparently killed by the battalion, Alita realized how\nmuch she cared about him and tried to attack [Colonel\nBozzle](/wiki/Colonel_Bozzle \"Colonel Bozzle\"){.mw-redirect} in a rage,\nbut he blew off her legs below the knees using her own\n[rifle](/wiki/TUNED_rifle \"TUNED rifle\"). Figure again saved Alita again\nby killing [Knucklehead](/wiki/Knucklehead \"Knucklehead\") when he was\nabout to duel her, and she revealed that she liked him when she welcomed\nhis kiss. After the death of Yolg, the two set off for Alhambra,\npersisting when they ran out of gas and water, although Figure had to\ncarry Alita because she could not walk. When she told him he could leave\nher behind, he refused, confessing that he was free to carry the woman\nhe had fallen for. They were about to die in the middle of the desert\nwhen Bigott manipulated the weather patterns and had the skies open up\nand pour down water and fish on them. After arriving at Alhambra, Alita\npromised to return to Figure while he waited for her, telling him not to\ncheat on her.\n\n<figure class=\"thumb show-info-icon\" typeof=\"mw:File/Thumb\"\nstyle=\"width: 180px\">\n<a\nhref=\"https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/battleangel/images/1/1f/BAA09_253_Alita_%26_Figure.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20110307203345\"\nclass=\"mw-file-description image\"><img\nsrc=\"data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D\"\nclass=\"thumbimage lazyload\" decoding=\"async\" loading=\"lazy\"\ndata-image-name=\"BAA09 253 Alita &amp; Five years after Alita fused with the\n[sky hook]{.new title=\"Sky hook (page does not exist)\"\nuncrawlable-url=\"L3dpa2kvU2t5X2hvb2s/YWN0aW9uPWVkaXQmcmVkbGluaz0x\"} and\nformed the [Life-Tree]{.new title=\"Life-Tree (page does not exist)\"\nuncrawlable-url=\"L3dpa2kvTGlmZS1UcmVlP2FjdGlvbj1lZGl0JnJlZGxpbms9MQ==\"}\nto save [Tiphares](/wiki/Tiphares \"Tiphares\"){.mw-redirect} and the\n[Scrapyard](/wiki/Scrapyard \"Scrapyard\"), Figure journeyed to [Ketheres\nElyion]{.new title=\"Ketheres Elyion (page does not exist)\"\nuncrawlable-url=\"L3dpa2kvS2V0aGVyZXNfRWx5aW9uP2FjdGlvbj1lZGl0JnJlZGxpbms9MQ==\"}\nwhere he was found by [Koyomi](/wiki/Koyomi \"Koyomi\"){.mw-redirect}.\nWhen she told him that Alita was dead, he violently refused to believe\nher and after encountering a senile [Desty\nNova](/wiki/Desty_Nova \"Desty Nova\"), demanded to know where Alita was.\nNova lead them to a chamber inside the trunk of the Life-Tree where a\ngiant bulb was growing. Seeing something inside the bulb, Figure broke\nit and was reunited with Alita, who had been regenerated in a\n[human](/wiki/Human \"Human\") body in the manga\\'s original ending.\n\nIn *[Last Order](/wiki/Last_Order \"Last Order\"){.mw-redirect},* it was\nshown that Figure never forgot about her and was still waiting for Alita\nto return; he even announced his intention to marry Alita despite his\nmaster [Tauro Four]{.new title=\"Tauro Four (page does not exist)\"\nuncrawlable-url=\"L3dpa2kvVGF1cm9fRm91cj9hY3Rpb249ZWRpdCZyZWRsaW5rPTE=\"}\\'s\ndoubts. After discovering a [TUNED\npistol](/wiki/TUNED_pistol \"TUNED pistol\") being sold by a caravan, he\nsets off to discover what has happened to Alita.\n\n### [[Yolg](/wiki/Yolg \"Yolg\")]{#Yolg The two happened to be stationed in the same\nrail car and thus got to know each other. The bond between them was\nstrengthened when Factory Train 12 was derailed and Yolg\\'s leg was\nbroken, prompting Figure to come to his aid. They later searched the\nBoiling Metal Battalion\\'s base for food, and Figure defended Yolg from\nAlita when she was about to pistol-whip him. Despite Yolg\\'s betrayal\nwhen he shielded Colonel Bozzle from being attacked by Alita, he repaid\nFigure and Alita when he refused to fire on them after being turned into\na [socket soldier](/wiki/Socket_soldier \"Socket soldier\") and turned on\nBozzle. practitioner of an anti-cyborg [martial art]{.new\ntitle=\"Martial art (page does not exist)\"\nuncrawlable-url=\"L3dpa2kvTWFydGlhbF9hcnQ/YWN0aW9uPWVkaXQmcmVkbGluaz0x\"}.\nHe is especially deadly in close quarters, where he can make use of\n\\\"teai\\\" attacks that take advantage of those attacks which originate at\nthe elbow, making them faster than those using punches that originate at\nthe shoulder, such as\n--\nIn spite or because of his abilities, Figure seems to have a tendency to\nget into fights with cyborgs. Up to his fight with Alita, he had beaten\n35 cyborgs in combat with the ultimate aim of beating a thousand because\nof his techniques. These victories were also due in part to the fact\nthat his opponents had not been as skilled fighters and tend to\nunderestimate him because he had no cyborg enhancements. Alita was the\nonly cyborg Figure has fought who managed to defeat him. He emerged from\nhis other fights relatively unscathed until he fought Sechs.\n\n**Enhanced durability**: Despite being flesh and blood, Figure is very\nresilient and hardy, likely as a result of his background as a fisherman\nand practice of koppo. During his fight with Alita he kept persisting in\nattempting to fight her despite getting beat down again and again. He\nwas able to bind his arm after his forearm had been severed and drag\nhimself and [AR-4](/wiki/AR-4 \"AR-4\") into a river, surviving to be\nrecovered at [Farm 21](/wiki/Farm_21 \"Farm 21\").\n\n## [Equipment]{#Equipment that he was raised by his master [Tauro Four]{.new\ntitle=\"Tauro Four (page does not exist)\"\nuncrawlable-url=\"L3dpa2kvVGF1cm9fRm91cj9hY3Rpb249ZWRpdCZyZWRsaW5rPTE=\"}\nin [Alhambra](/wiki/Alhambra \"Alhambra\"). He grew up to be a fisherman\nbut also became a practitioner of the anti-cyborg martial art known as\n[Koppo]{.new title=\"Koppo (page does not exist)\"\nuncrawlable-url=\"L3dpa2kvS29wcG8/YWN0aW9uPWVkaXQmcmVkbGluaz0x\"}. As a\nchild, he learned from [his village](/wiki/Alhambra \"Alhambra\")\\'s\nrainmaker a song that would summon a rainstorm when played and would\npractice it on a harmonica he owned or had in his family\\'s possession.\nAs an adult, he decided to leave Alhambra and would travel for a year\nthroughout the Badlands and the [Scrapyard](/wiki/Scrapyard \"Scrapyard\")\nin order to see [Tiphares](/wiki/Tiphares \"Tiphares\"){.mw-redirect}.\n\n## [Plot]{#Plot As the train travelled through the Badlands, he heard a\nharmonica playing and came across [Alita](/wiki/Alita \"Alita\") playing\nit atop the train. Despite Yolg\\'s warnings, he became intrigued by her\nand boldly took the harmonica from her hands. While his efforts to play\nfailed, he was able to get introduced to her. Although when he noticed\nAlita\\'s [rifle](/wiki/TUNED_rifle \"TUNED rifle\") as being different\nfrom the other guns given to the mercenaries, she warned him to stay\naway from her. The appearance of\n[Knucklehead](/wiki/Knucklehead \"Knucklehead\")'s squad on\n[Gabriel](/wiki/Gabriel \"Gabriel\"){.mw-redirect}\\'s radar warned Alita\nabout the pending attack, which she focused on to Figure\\'s puzzlement.\nWhen the squad attacked the train and it was derailed, Figure and Yolg\nwere thrown from the train, although the latter\\'s leg was broken.\nFigure was able to save Yolg from Knucklehead himself, and was in turn\nsaved by Alita who used his shoulder to brace her rifle. She then threw\nthem both at the train to prevent their\n[rent-a-gun](/wiki/Rent-a-gun \"Rent-a-gun\") packs from detonating. After\nthe nuclear reactor began to melt down, Figure thought that they were\nfinished as the rent-a-gun computer had been damaged by the derailment,\nbut he and Yolg were again rescued by Alita, who was able to hack into\nand remove their packs. She took them away in a [buggy]{.new\ntitle=\"Buggy (page does not exist)\"\nuncrawlable-url=\"L3dpa2kvQnVnZ3k/YWN0aW9uPWVkaXQmcmVkbGluaz0x\"} from the\ntrain before the reactor exploded. That night Figure challenged Alita to\na fight after learning that she planned to leave him and Yolg in the\nmiddle of the desert, but was soundly beaten by her. After leaving,\nAlita changed her mind when she learned from [Bigott\nEizenburg](/wiki/Bigott_Eizenburg \"Bigott Eizenburg\") that a massive\ntornado had been triggered by the nuclear explosion, and returned for\nFigure and Yolg.\n\nHowever their jeep got caught up in the tornado and wound up on the edge\nof a skyscraper. Figure was able to save them, but as payback for his\ntreatment by Alita, suspended her from the building. He later shimmied\ndown to have a talk with Alita. Although the two opened up to each\nother, Figure\\'s taunting set Alita off and she kicked him hard, making\nhim lose his grip on the rope he was hanging onto. After she managed to\ngrab him with her legs and threatened to drop him, the\n[Barjack](/wiki/Barjack \"Barjack\")\\'s [Boiling Metal\nBattalion](/wiki/Boiling_Metal_Battalion \"Boiling Metal Battalion\"),\nwhich had returned to their base, attacked. Alita saved Yolg and Figure\nwhen the building they were on was hit and collapsed. While hiding,\nFigure called into question Alita\\'s bloodlust and desire for battle,\nmaking her think about her motivations. As she fought the Barjack, he\ndecided to help her after realizing that she was less free than he was\nbecause she could not choose not to fight. He hijacked a Barjack vehicle\nmounting a [minigun]{.new title=\"Minigun (page does not exist)\"\nuncrawlable-url=\"L3dpa2kvTWluaWd1bj9hY3Rpb249ZWRpdCZyZWRsaW5rPTE=\"}\nafter the rest of the battalion His fair hair is always shown styled in a high brush cut and\nhe wears eyeglasses without temples. When he first appeared his hair was\nbushier but this aspect was scaled back in later chapters. In the\n[OVA](/wiki/Battle_Angel_(OVA) \"Battle Angel (OVA)\") and *[Gunnm:\nMartian Memory](/wiki/Gunnm:_Martian_Memory \"Gunnm: Martian Memory\")*,\nIdo is blond. He looks like a younger version of [Dr.\nRussell](/wiki/Dr._Russell \"Dr. Russell\"){.mw-redirect}, suggesting that\nthey share the same genetic stock, a common occurrence on Tiphares. Like\nall adult [Tiphareans](/wiki/Tipharean \"Tipharean\"){.mw-redirect}, he\nbears a tattoo on his forehead signifying that he has undergone the\n\\\"initiation\\\" required to become a citizen of Tiphares.\n\nWhen working in his clinic, Ido wears a white lab coat with a dress\nshirt, tie, and slacks. When he would go out or was working as a\nhunter-warrior, he wore a black [trench coat]{.new\ntitle=\"Trench coat (page does not exist)\"\nuncrawlable-url=\"L3dpa2kvVHJlbmNoX2NvYXQ/YWN0aW9uPWVkaXQmcmVkbGluaz0x\"}\nand matching hat with a circular brim. The trench coat is brown in the\nOVA. After he erased his memories and relocating to [Farm\n21](/wiki/Farm_21 \"Farm 21\"), Ido practices full time as a\ncyberphysician and appears to have stopped wearing the trench coat and\nhat.\n\nIdo\\'s appearance is very similar to a character who appeared in [Yukito\nKishiro](/wiki/Yukito_Kishiro \"Yukito Kishiro\")\\'s earlier doujinshi\n*[Iron Fist](/wiki/Iron_Fist \"Iron Fist\")*. This character is a man with\nglasses who wears a black hat and trench coat and wields a large hammer,\nthe titular iron fist, that he transports in a rolling case.\n\n### [Gallery]{#Gallery
